scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/widget && npm run typecheck -w packages/server
scripts.start: npm run build -w packages/widget && npm run dev -w packages/server
scripts.start:dev: concurrently --names "widget,server" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run build:dev -w packages/widget" "npm run dev -w packages/server"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/widget && npm run typecheck -w packages/server
